messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that fell in Canada during 2023. (Dates are the actual holiday dates; the “long weekend” usually includes the adjacent weekend days.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 (Friday) | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | July 1 (Saturday) – observed July 3 (Monday) | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | September 4 (Monday) | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | October 9 (Monday) | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | November 11 (Monday) | Nov 9–11 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Christmas Day** | December 25 (Monday) | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) |

These are the federal holidays that created at least a three‑day stretch (including the weekend) in 2023. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, British Columbia, etc.) let me know and I can add those too.
